blanks.note: NBRM Annual Report 2024 (https://www.nbrm.mk/content/Annual_Report_2024-NB.pdf) now READ IN FULL — all 349,275 characters, in four WebFetch windows (0-100k read in r68, plus 100k-200k, 200k-300k, 300k-end this round). Section VI 'Foreign reserves management and investment' (pp. 49-52 and the detailed discussion at pp. 102-110) says the Financial Market Operations Department carries out the foreign reserves management itself and the Investment Committee monitors implementation of the Foreign Reserves Management and Investment Guidelines; no outside manager, no externally managed portfolio. World Bank appears only as technical cooperation on a possible digital currency; the BIS appears only as a securities ISSUER in a chart footnote ('*IMF, BIS are classified in the category others') and in footnote 115 on the BIS Cyber Resilience Coordination Centre. No RAMP, BlackRock, Amundi, PIMCO, UBS or Crown Agents anywhere. The ECB line noted in r68 is a repo liquidity facility, not management. One residual route only: this annual report ENDS with the abbreviations list and carries no notes to the financial statements, so the separately published NBRM audited financial statements have still not been grepped.
blanks.host_notes: nbrm.mk returns a Cloudflare challenge to curl; WebFetch with offset works and is the way to read it.

blanks.note: Central Bank of The Bahamas Annual Report and Financial Statements 2022 (https://www.centralbankbahamas.com/viewPDF/documents/2023-05-09-12-27-39-2022-CB0B-Annual-Report-and-FS.pdf) opened through WebFetch (the host that refused curl in r68 serves fine to WebFetch) and the notes read at offset 200000 of 346,864 characters. THE BANK DOES USE AN OUTSIDE MANAGER AND DOES NOT NAME IT: Note 2(c)(i) classifies 'Marketable Securities which are managed by a third party' at fair value through profit or loss, with information provided internally to the Investment Management Committee; Note 8 'Marketable Securities' states 'These represent securities that are externally managed by a third party'; Note 7 by contrast calls Foreign Government Securities 'internally managed marketable securities'. Note 30 adds that the Bank 'holds various sinking funds with an external broker on behalf of The Government which totaled $41,942,844' — fiduciary, for the Government, broker not named, and not reserves. No firm name, no RAMP, no BIS, no Crown Agents, no BlackRock anywhere in the notes; the World Bank appears in Note 21 only as a depositor. This is the strongest unnamed-manager lead on the row: the fact is confirmed, only the counterparty is missing. Next step for a later round: the 2024 or 2025 edition of the same document at the same path pattern, and the Bahamas Auditor-General / Public Accounts tabling, which may name the third party.
blanks.host_notes: centralbankbahamas.com 404s/403s to curl but serves through WebFetch; read with offset, the notes start near character 200000.

blanks.note: Central Bank of Belize Annual Report 2020 (https://www.centralbank.org.bz/docs/default-source/4.2.4-annual-reports/annual-report-2020.pdf?sfvrsn=2, 8.2 MB, includes the Independent Auditor's Report and the full Notes to the Financial Statements for 2020 and 2019) downloaded by plain curl and grepped in full: zero hits for externally managed, external manager, fund manager, investment manager, RAMP, Reserve Advisory, Crown Agents, BlackRock, Amundi, PIMCO, UBS, Wellington, World Bank or IBRD. Every 'manag*' hit is a staff job title or risk-management prose. The approved-external-assets disclosures (cash-and-cash-equivalents breakdown and Note 27 'Interest on approved external assets') give balances and interest only and name no counterparty. The 2019 audited statements (https://centralbank.org.bz/docs/default-source/4.3.2-cbb-annual-statements/fs-2019.pdf?sfvrsn=2) were downloaded and grepped the same way: the only hit is 'IBRD/SEK' as a column heading in the foreign securities exposure table — an ISSUER of securities held, not a manager, and it does not clear the no-upgrading rule. The Crown Agents Investment Management hypothesis for Belize is therefore not supported by the bank's own audited statements. Vein for Belize is effectively closed on the annual-report/statements route; centralbank.org.bz serves PDFs to curl, so a later round can cheaply grep fs-2022 through fs-2025 off the detail pages.
blanks.host_notes: centralbank.org.bz serves PDFs to plain curl.

blanks.note: Centrale Bank van Suriname Jaarverslag/Jaarrekening 2018, published on the Government of Suriname host (https://gov.sr/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Centrale-Bank-van-Suriname-CBvS-Jaarrekening-2018.pdf, 8.0 MB) — this is the parliamentary/government vein and it serves to plain curl. Downloaded and grepped in full for externally managed, external manager, beheerder, vermogensbeheer, extern beheer, RAMP, Crown Agents, BlackRock, Amundi, PIMCO, UBS, Wellington, World Bank, IBRD: no hits (the only 'extern' hit is 'externe actuarius', an external ACTUARY valuing pension provisions for former Bank presidents, not reserves). The accounting-policy note and note 2.1 'Vorderingen op correspondentbanken en beleggingen' describe the foreign assets as working balances held at international correspondent banks plus short- and long-term beleggingen (investments) carried at transaction value, plus IMF SDR holdings; the Bank describes them as its own and names no manager and no correspondent. Confirmed blank on the audited statements. Residual route: the later CBvS jaarrekeningen (2022-2024) on cbvs.sr, not opened.
blanks.host_notes: cbvs.sr itself served only weekly condensed balance sheets in search; gov.sr carries the full jaarrekeningen and answers curl.
